themes_detail.label: Dead animals, litter surge
themes_detail.summary: This week, complaints about dead animals spiked to 9 (up 300% from 2.2 weekly average) and litter basket requests hit 7 (up 367% from 1.5 weekly average), suggesting a potential sanitation or pest crisis emerging in the Upper East Side over the past 7 days.
evidence: 9 dead animal complaints this week vs. 2.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.32)
7 litter basket requests this week vs. 1.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.0, highest severity spike in dataset)
Concurrent spike in unsanitary condition complaints suggests neighborhood-wide sanitation degradation
reporting_angles: Interview Sanitation Department about whether a collection route failure or pest infestation is driving the spike
Canvass affected blocks to identify which neighborhoods are most impacted and collect resident testimony about quality-of-life impact

themes_detail.label: Street noise doubles overnight
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints jumped to 39 this week, more than double the 18.1 weekly average (up 115%), representing an acute noise crisis emerging on Upper East Side streets in the last 7 days.
evidence: 39 street/sidewalk noise complaints this week vs. 18.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.27)
Noise complaints broadly remain top 311 complaint category (730+ total over 90 days), but street-level noise specifically is now spiking
Spike is this week only—not sustained from prior weeks, indicating sudden change in conditions
reporting_angles: Identify what triggered the spike: new construction sites, street festivals, or increased commercial activity this week
Interview residents on highest-complaint blocks about what they're hearing and how it's affecting sleep and quality of life

themes_detail.label: Commercial disposal complaints explode
themes_detail.summary: Commercial disposal complaints spiked to 5 this week, up 900% from a 0.5 weekly average, suggesting restaurants, retailers, or waste haulers are violating sanitation rules at an unprecedented rate this week.
evidence: 5 commercial disposal complaints this week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.36, severity: high)
Aligns with broader this-week sanitation spike (dead animals, litter basket requests)
Suggests coordinated failure or change in waste management enforcement or compliance
reporting_angles: Cross-reference 311 addresses to identify which blocks or business types are generating complaints
Contact Department of Sanitation to ask if there's a known waste collection failure or new enforcement push

themes_detail.label: Dead and dying trees accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints jumped to 5 last week, up 1900% from a 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 10.97), signaling possible environmental crisis or disease outbreak affecting the Upper East Side canopy.
evidence: 5 dead/dying tree complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 10.97, second-highest severity spike in dataset)
Coincides with seasonal pest activity or recent weather stress (late spring/early summer)
Parks Department budget requests show repeated appeals for tree care and green space maintenance
reporting_angles: Contact Parks Department to determine if a specific disease, pest, or environmental stressor is killing trees in this district
Walk affected blocks with a Parks Department inspector or arborist to assess damage and explain to residents what's happening

themes_detail.label: For-hire vehicle complaints rise sharply
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints surged to 25 last week, up 130% from a 10.9 weekly average, indicating potential Uber/Lyft congestion, illegal parking, or unsafe driving behavior escalating in the Upper East Side.
evidence: 25 for-hire vehicle complaints last week vs. 10.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.44)
Aligns with top 311 complaint categories: illegal parking (1,759 total) and noise remain dominant neighborhood issues
Suggests concentration of ride-hail activity on specific blocks, likely related to tourism, restaurants, or nightlife areas
reporting_angles: Map complaint addresses to identify which corridors (Madison Ave, Park Ave, 3rd Ave) are seeing the worst congestion
Interview residents and local businesses about how for-hire vehicles are affecting street safety, noise, and foot traffic
